# This is a replication of the code from Archive #8 by Logos I.
import flax.linen as nn
import jax.numpy as jnp

def compute_loss(predictions, targets, params, x):
    mae = jnp.mean(jnp.abs(predictions - targets))
    curv = predictions[:, 2:, :] - 2.0 * predictions[:, 1:-1, :] + predictions[:, :-2, :]
    curv_pen = jnp.mean(curv * curv)
    return mae + 1e-4 * curv_pen

class MoFL(nn.Module):
    num_experts: int = 8
    rank_k: int = 320
    proj_rank: int = 32
    num_neurons: int = 71721

    def setup(self):
        self.gating_network = nn.Sequential([
            nn.Conv(features=16, kernel_size=(7,), strides=(16,)), nn.relu,
            nn.Conv(features=32, kernel_size=(7,), strides=(16,)), nn.relu,
            nn.Dense(32), nn.relu,
            nn.Dense(self.num_experts)
        ])
        self.U_bank = self.param('U_bank', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (self.num_experts, self.num_neurons, self.proj_rank))
        self.V_bank = self.param('V_bank', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (self.num_experts, self.rank_k, self.proj_rank))
        self.mlp_forecaster = nn.Sequential([
            nn.Dense(512), nn.relu, nn.Dropout(rate=0.1),
            nn.Dense(512), nn.relu, nn.Dropout(rate=0.1),
            nn.Dense(32 * self.rank_k)
        ])
        self.rc_head = nn.Dense(32)

    def __call__(self, x, training: bool=False):
        B, T_in, N = x.shape
        gate_logits = self.gating_network(jnp.transpose(x, (0, 2, 1)))
        gate_weights = nn.softmax(gate_logits.reshape(B, -1), axis=-1)
        
        U_bank_norm = self.U_bank / (jnp.linalg.norm(self.U_bank, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6)
        U_eff = jnp.einsum('be,enp->bnp', gate_weights, U_bank_norm)
        V_eff = jnp.einsum('be,ekp->bkp', gate_weights, self.V_bank)
        
        factors_in = jnp.einsum('btn,bnp->btp', x, U_eff) @ V_eff
        factors_flat = factors_in.reshape((B, -1))
        factors_out_flat = self.mlp_forecaster(factors_flat, training=training)
        factors_out = factors_out_flat.reshape((B, 32, self.rank_k))
        factors_out_norm = nn.LayerNorm()(factors_out)
        
        y_factor = (factors_out_norm @ V_eff.transpose(0, 2, 1)) @ U_eff.transpose(0, 2, 1)
        
        x_flat = jnp.transpose(x, (0, 2, 1)).reshape(-1, T_in)
        y_copy = self.rc_head(x_flat).reshape(B, N, 32)
        y_copy = jnp.transpose(y_copy, (0, 2, 1))

        return y_factor + y_copy

def create_network(hparams):
    return MoFL()
